entities.name: Authentication and key agreement procedure for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay
entities.description: Performs authentication for 5G ProSe remote UE initiated by the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay and agrees on KAUSF_P and KNR_ProSe keys when security for 5G ProSe communication via relay is performed over control plane.

entities.name: RELAY KEY REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to AMF to initiate the authentication and key agreement procedure for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay.

entities.name: RELAY KEY REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to UE to reject the relay key request, optionally containing EAP-failure message.

entities.name: RELAY AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to UE containing EAP-request messages for authentication.

entities.name: RELAY AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to AMF containing EAP-response messages to authentication requests.

entities.name: RELAY KEY ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to UE to accept the relay key request, containing EAP-success message.

entities.name: T35xx
entities.description: Timer used during the authentication and key agreement procedure for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay.

entities.name: Network decides to process relay key request
entities.description: Condition where the network decides to process the relay key request message, initiating EAP-based authentication.

entities.name: KAUSF_P and KNR_ProSe keys agreed
entities.description: Property indicating successful agreement of KAUSF_P and KNR_ProSe keys during the authentication procedure.

relations.description: Procedure is initiated by UE sending RELAY KEY REQUEST message.
Sending RELAY KEY REQUEST starts timer T35xx.
Receiving RELAY KEY REJECT stops timer T35xx.
Receiving RELAY AUTHENTICATION REQUEST stops timer T35xx.
Sending RELAY AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE starts timer T35xx.
Receiving RELAY KEY ACCEPT stops timer T35xx.
Procedure proceeds with EAP-based authentication if network decides to process relay key request.
Successful procedure execution establishes agreement on KAUSF_P and KNR_ProSe keys.
